entry.summary:
In New Zealand, Radiation Therapists walk alongside their patients from the initial appointment through to the final treatment. This rare international scope of practice offers a rewarding career where the care you deliver truly matters.

The autonomy to practise across the full scope. And a life worth living outside of it.

Visit our website to find out more: http://healthnz.govt.nz/RT
